drafts.draft_en:
To the guys in my DMs asking how to get into real estate while watching every story 👀

Philly, we need a meeting.

You've got the Eagles season tickets, the new Jordans, and a Wawa tab that could cover a utility bill…

but you "can't afford" to start?

Let's talk about where your money is really going.
drafts.pattern: Regional call-out with humor (@justhomesgroup, 97.4k and 80 replies in under a day): name the audience, list local status symbols, end with a turn that invites replies. Localized to Philly. No returns or prices promised.
drafts.video_tip: Selfie-style, 12–15s, standing on a Philly block. Deliver it like a mock-serious 'family meeting' and hold up a finger for each item (tickets, Jordans, Wawa). Burn in captions. End with a deadpan look at the camera. Pin a reply that asks: 'What's the ONE thing you'd cut first?'

drafts.draft_en:
You're 30. Living in Philly.
Renting at $1,600 a month.
$20K saved. No property.

Are you doing alright, or should you be further ahead by now?
drafts.pattern: Benchmark question (HughInvests at 8.6k in ~2h, TheREDevGUY's net-worth-by-age question): a concrete profile, then a yes/no judgment that invites replies. Localized to Philly renters. Gives no advice and promises nothing.
drafts.video_tip: Text-only works best. For video: 6–8s, each line pops on screen over b-roll of a Philly rowhome street, then hold on the last line for 2s. No voiceover.

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, I'm 30, I live in Philly, and I have $40K saved.

Choose ONE to start building generational wealth:

• House hack a duplex and rent out the other unit
• Buy a cheap rowhome that needs work and fix it up
• Keep renting and invest it all in index funds

Be brutally honest.
drafts.pattern: The 'Hey @grok' + pick-ONE fork is cooling, but changed-numbers variants still climb (c_erraaa +3.0k to 28.4k). Localized to Philly with options for small budgets. Asks for opinions only and promises no returns.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head, 10s. Read it as if you're asking Grok out loud, with each option on screen as written. Burn in captions. After replies come in, pin your own take, with a clear note that every option carries risk.
